records.title: Manifestations of potential xylazine withdrawal: A retrospective cohort study with nested case series.
records.source_title: Manifestations of potential xylazine withdrawal: A retrospective cohort study with nested case series.
records.abstract: Source-verified synopsis: A retrospective cohort of 121 hospitalized patients compared vital signs and intensive-care outcomes by urine xylazine detection. Seventy-three tested positive. There was no observed association with higher peak blood pressure or heart rate. Chart review found only two possible withdrawal presentations with otherwise unexplained cardiovascular signs. Co-occurring withdrawal syndromes and retrospective ascertainment limit conclusions; no distinct syndrome was established.
records.relevance_reason: Human negative findings and uncertainty about a potential withdrawal syndrome.
records.study_design: retrospective cohort and nested case series
records.population: Hospitalized patients with urine xylazine testing
records.intervention: Observed exposure classification, not an assigned treatment
outcomes: No higher peak vital-sign measurements associated with detection
Two possible withdrawal presentations among 73 exposed patients
records.uncertainty: Retrospective confounding and overlapping withdrawal syndromes; no causal inference
records.adverse_effects: No distinct withdrawal syndrome demonstrated in this sample
records.interactions: Concurrent withdrawal from other substances was common
